list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The discrete tetragadolinium polyoxoanion consists of two divacant Lindqvist [W4O16] units, each bearing two Gd centers, joined by two oxalate ligands into a rectangular Gd4 core. Sodium–oxygen chains connect the polyoxoanions into a three-dimensional porous framework with channels of approximately 4.40 Å radius.

synthesis.procedure: Dissolve sodium tungstate dihydrate and oxalic acid in 20 mL distilled water with stirring. Adjust to pH 7.5 with HCl and stir for 20 min. Add GdCl3, stir for a further 0.5 h, heat in a 90 °C water bath for 2 h, and filter. Slowly evaporate the filtrate at ambient temperature for approximately one week.
synthesis.temperature: 90 °C water bath; ambient temperature during evaporation
synthesis.time: 20 min initial stirring; 0.5 h after GdCl3 addition; 2 h heating; approximately 1 week evaporation
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Aqueous synthesis in a water bath followed by slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filter the heated solution; slow evaporation of the filtrate at ambient temperature gives colorless square lamellar crystals.

title: Double-Oxalate-Bridging Tetralanthanide Containing Divacant Lindqvist Isopolytungstates with an Energy Transfer Mechanism and Luminous Color Adjustability Through Eu3+/Tb3+ Codoping
